title: Automated RNA Extraction for SARS-CoV-2
author: Maria Greco
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfb5jiq6
materials: Move plate to Shaker for 2 min
Move plate to Magnet for 5 min
Move plate to the Shaker for 20 sec
Move plate to the Magnet for 60 sec
Move plate from the magnet to position P8
Move plate to the Shaker for 5 min
Move plate to the magnet for 60 sec
When then program is complete, remove the Eppendorf 96-well skirted plate from the deck, and seal with a Thermo Adhesive PCR plate seal.

steps.title: Open Biomek software and select program
steps.instruction: Launch the Biomek FX2 software, open the “Covid‑19” project and select the program “RNA Extraction vFINAL”.

steps.title: View deck layout
steps.instruction: Click “Instrument Setup” to display the FX2 deck layout.

steps.title: Load filter tip boxes
steps.instruction: Place four boxes (lid off) of 250 µL green filter tips and three boxes (lid off) of 50 µL pink filter tips on the deck as shown.

steps.title: Load plates and magnetic module
steps.instruction: Place an Axygen Deep‑well plate in position P12; a 96‑well Nunc plate for bead‑mix in P9; a 96‑well Nunc plate for PE buffer in P8; a 96‑well Nunc plate for TET buffer in P15; the sample plate (seal removed) in P10; an empty LoBind 96‑well plate with pre‑printed SPL barcode in P16; and the Alpaqua Magnum FLX magnetic plate in P13.

steps.title: Prepare silica beads
steps.instruction: Retrieve the 1.5 mL tube containing 550 µL pre‑aliquoted silica beads from the fridge, vortex to resuspend, and record the bead manufacturer and LOT number.

steps.title: Wash beads three times with TET
steps.instruction: Perform three successive washes of the beads with TET buffer.

substeps.instruction: Place the bead tube on a single‑tube magnet for 1 min (00:01:00) or until the supernatant is clear; discard supernatant into the tip waste bin.
Remove tube, add 550 µL TET, vortex to resuspend.
Pulse‑spin, place on magnet for 1 min, discard supernatant.
Repeat the above three‑step cycle two more times (total of three washes).

steps.title: Final bead suspension
steps.instruction: After the third wash, remove the tube from the magnet, add 550 µL TET, vortex, and pulse‑spin to collect the beads.

steps.title: Combine beads with binding buffer
steps.instruction: Add the bead suspension to the 50 mL Falcon tube containing pre‑aliquoted Binding Buffer (BB), invert the tube several times to mix well.

steps.title: Aliquot bead‑mix to deep‑well plate
steps.instruction: Using a multichannel pipette, dispense 400 µL of the bead‑mix into each well of the 96‑well Nunc plate placed in position P9.

steps.title: Aliquot PE buffer
steps.instruction: Dispense 600 µL PE buffer into each well of the Nunc plate positioned in P8.

steps.title: Aliquot TET buffer
steps.instruction: Dispense 0.6 mL (600 µL) certified TET buffer into each well of the Nunc plate positioned in P15.

steps.title: Prepare sample plate
steps.instruction: If samples were stored, briefly spin the sample plate in a plate centrifuge, then place the seal‑removed plate in position P10.

steps.title: Power on auxiliary equipment
steps.instruction: Ensure the Inheco unit (blue box next to the FX monitor) is switched ON.

steps.title: Launch extraction in LIMS
steps.instruction: On the laptop beside the FX, start the Extraction step in ClarityLIMS (see COVID‑19 LIMS walkthrough).

steps.title: Start robot run
steps.instruction: Press the Run button (green triangle) in the Biomek software; the robot will execute the automated sequence described below.

substeps.instruction: 1) Transfer 150 µL of each sample to 400 µL Binding Buffer + beads (2.6× volume) and mix 10× by pipetting up/down.
2) Move the plate to the shaker for 5 min.
3) Move the plate to position P8 and mix 20×.
6) Place the plate on the magnet for 5 min.
8) Transfer 180 µL PE buffer to each well (Wash 1); shake 20 s; magnet 60 s; remove supernatant.
9) Repeat steps 8‑12 two more times for Wash 2 and Wash 3 (total three PE washes).
10) After final wash, move plate to P8 and dry for 2 min.
11) Transfer 40 µL TET buffer to each well and mix 10×.
14) Transfer 35 µL eluate from each well to the LoBind 96‑well plate in position P16.

steps.title: Post‑run handling
steps.instruction: Proceed to qPCR RNA transfer or store the eluate plate at –80 °C until qPCR setup.
